verdict.rationale: Mastra explicitly supports cron-based agent/workflow scheduling, background tool calls that don't block the agentic loop, durable multi-iteration 'goals' the agent works toward autonomously, and workflow suspend/resume with snapshots for indefinite pausing — all core primitives for autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these scheduling/background features work reliably in production, and more detail on failure handling/monitoring for long-running unattended jobs.
